verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an executable project-artifact rule requiring portable, project-relative 3D-model references that resolve across machines.
First concrete portability failure: opening the project on Linux left most 3D models missing because their references depended on absolute Windows paths and unavailable local libraries.
The client adds a concrete KiCad 9 compatibility rule for third-party library references; no existing attribute becomes obsolete or conflicts with this added rule.
